genre.description: Low strings, guitar, bass, synth texture, sparse brass and an unresolved electronic tail.

rhythm.pulse_description: A purposeful low pulse strengthens after 15 seconds, locks into mechanical forward drive around 30 seconds, opens near 78 seconds and recedes after 89 seconds.
rhythm.meter_or_groove: Slow duple/4-4 cinematic groove with restrained trip-hop and industrial relay character; no EDM drop.

sections.visual_function: Complete Claire's departure action without replaying the window revelation.
Expose the apartment threshold, latch and first ordered building relays.
Carry Claire through the hallway while separate apartments coordinate.
Support the elevator's prepared route and physically ordinary system behavior.
Reveal the lobby access system routing occupants outward.
Open onto the rainy street as traffic and transit systems reorganize.
Let the public display and calm civic response become unmistakable.
End with Claire moving forward into Paris and preserve momentum for Scene 04.

energy_curve: Low but immediate at the opening, briefly thinned at 8 seconds, steadily rising from 15 seconds, strongest from 30-78 seconds, opened at 78-89 seconds, then unresolved rather than conclusively resolved.
narrative_function: Move the film from private warning to physical departure and public systemic proof while making the transition feel prepared, intelligent and inevitable rather than chaotic.
mix_policy: The full mix is editorial authority. Stems may create smooth space for Foley and system events using ramps only; no hard score cuts. Generated video music/dialogue is discarded, while useful isolated ambience or Foley may be reviewed separately.
